name: bugfix
description: Kiro SDD bugfix workflow: symptom capture, 5-whys root cause analysis, preserved behavior check, red-to-green testing, and patch verification

steps.prompt: Scaffold bugfix specification for '{{inputs.name}}' in domain '{{inputs.domain}}'. Run `npm run spec:new -- --name {{inputs.name}} --domain {{inputs.domain}} --title "{{inputs.title}}" --type bugfix`.

In docs/specs/{{inputs.domain}}/{{inputs.name}}/brief.json, complete: 1) Symptom & exact reproduction steps; 2) 5-Whys Root Cause Analysis; 3) Preserved Behavior (must not break existing normal flows). Run `npm run spec:build -- --name {{inputs.name}}`.

Wave 1: Write an automated reproduction unit/integration test using real database in packages/plugins/plugin-{{inputs.domain}}/tests/. Run the test to confirm it stably FAILS (Red Test). Commit with [T1].
Wave 2: Apply the minimal, non-breaking patch to the service/repository. Run the test to confirm it now PASSES (Green Test), and verify Preserved Behaviors remain intact. Commit with [T2].
Wave 3: Run `npm run check && npm run test:matrix`. Verify task commits with `npm run task:verify -- --spec {{inputs.name}} --summary`. Ensure zero regression and zero fake mocks.
